cpu_threads_note: effective_cores = process CPU time / wall time; onnxruntime intra-op threads spin-wait, so this overstates useful work. Default session used ORT defaults on 24 logical CPUs (12 physical); the _t4 variant sets intra_op_num_threads=4.

friction.parakeet_cpu: uv venv + uv pip install 'onnx-asr[hub]' onnxruntime; fp32 export fails to load straight from the HF cache (onnxruntime 1.31 rejects external-data symlinks escaping the model dir: 'External data path escapes model directory'), worked around by hard-linking the snapshot into a plain directory; int8 export loads from the cache directly.
friction.parakeet_gpu: separate venv with onnx-asr[hub] + onnxruntime-gpu 1.31.0 (CUDA 13.0 build, finds /opt/cuda cublas/cudart/curand) but attempt 1 failed: 'cuDNN is unavailable or disabled for CUDA Execution Provider: dlopen failed for libcudnn.so' (no cuDNN under /opt/cuda); attempt 2 = uv pip install nvidia-cudnn-cu13 into the scratch venv and LD_LIBRARY_PATH to its nvidia/*/lib dirs, worked (2 attempts).
friction.qwen3_asr: no install (voiceover/.venv-asr as is, run with python -I); weights were not cached, downloaded Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 4.4 GB.
